summary: Built a deterministic feasibility-analysis layer with 15 required categories, explicit mathematical lower-bounds, resource bottleneck analysis, immutable run versioning, server-side RBAC, separate schedule compliance verification, and professional analytical UI. Golden schedule hashes and baseline invariants preserved byte-for-byte.
known_limitations: Pure analytical lower-bound feasibility analysis; no automated generation or schedule mutation performed.
Non-hard constraints and preferences are evaluated solely for scheduling friction without producing hard infeasibility certificates.
